0022600027.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers, 4-4 and 3-1 at home, host the Philadelphia 76ers in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game, the Cavaliers' ninth of the season. Cleveland is on a two-game losing streak and sits 6th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 2 games back, while Philadelphia is 8-1, on a five-game winning streak, and leads the East and the Atlantic. Jaylon Tyson is out for Cleveland with an ankle sprain, and Jarrett Allen (knee), Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness) and Tyrese Proctor (ankle) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), with Adem Bona day-to-day with a back sprain. The Cavaliers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 114-106 loss in Philadelphia on October 22, and they won the 2025-26 series 4-0.
